description: This file defines an Android Service named WidgetUpdateService which periodically updates calendar and astrology widgets by interacting with widget classes and repositories.

classes.name: WidgetUpdateService
classes.description: An Android Service responsible for periodically updating calendar and astrology widgets.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the repository and starts the update cycle.

methods.name: onBind
methods.description: Returns null as binding is not used.

methods.name: startUpdateCycle
methods.description: Launches a coroutine that continuously updates widgets at set intervals.

methods.name: updateWidgets
methods.description: Updates all calendar and astrology widgets by calling their update methods.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Cancels the coroutine job to stop the update cycle.
